## Ctx.replyMediaGroup() method

Sends a Telegram media group using pipe-delimited `src` values or a `<media-group>` block from the page template.

**Signature:**

```typescript
replyMediaGroup(type?: ITMediaGroupType, data?: ITData, baseId?: string, options?: ITOptReplyPhoto | ITOptReplyVideo | ITOptReplyAudio | ITOptReplyDocument): Promise<(grammy_types.Message.PhotoMessage | grammy_types.Message.VideoMessage | grammy_types.Message.AudioMessage | grammy_types.Message.DocumentMessage | grammy_types.Message.LivePhotoMessage)[]>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;(grammy\_types.Message.PhotoMessage \| grammy\_types.Message.VideoMessage \| grammy\_types.Message.AudioMessage \| grammy\_types.Message.DocumentMessage \| grammy\_types.Message.LivePhotoMessage)\[\]&gt;

The sent media group messages.

## Remarks

Only `photo`<!-- -->, `video`<!-- -->, `audio`<!-- -->, and `document` support Telegram media groups. Omit `type` when the template uses `<media-group>` with per-item media types. The first item receives the template caption. Telegram media groups do not support reply markup, so keyboards are ignored for grouped media.

## Example


```typescript
async handleCallbackData() {
  await this.replyMediaGroup("photo")
}
```
